Description: Entity Body Description: gives the Body Descriptors Object of a Body Object (a picture of one body). The descriptors are the 33 keypoints of the body that BlazePose finds (MediaPipe Pose), each x, y, z and visibility: 132 numbers; the Qualifier of the Object names the format. The picture is put in the 256x256 square of the model with its proportions kept; there is no search for the body in a wider picture and no rotation of the body to the vertical. PS-Body Interpretation turns the keypoints into the Body Personal Status.
